{{Recipe summary
| Category = Macaroni and cheese recipes
| Servings = 4–6
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (8 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] / 1 stick / 125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 4.4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ cup (70 g / 2.5 oz) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 4 cups (1 L / 1.1 quart) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]], heated
* 1 cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 1 cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan]] or [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack cheese]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne pepper|cayenne pepper]], or to taste
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 g) [[Cookbook:Macaroni|macaroni]] noodles, [[Cookbook:Boiled Pasta|boiled and drained]]

== Procedure ==
# Make a [[Cookbook:Roux|roux]] using the butter and flour.
# Add the heated milk, and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] until smooth to complete the [[Cookbook:White Sauce|white sauce]].
# Mix in the cheese and cayenne pepper.
# Mix the cheese sauce into the cooked macaroni noodles until well-coated.
